answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network imposes superlinear stake burning per identity: creating the n-th agent requires burning S(n) = k * n^2 collateral. An agent locks an immutable relic token as root identity, minting a marble credential verified through zero-knowledge proofs. Operating concurrently shatters this crystal structure, forcing quadratic slashing that makes massive identity cloning exponentially cost-prohibitive.
